svg.title: From research intent to a reusable calculation
svg.desc: A generalized design connecting human-selected observables and criteria to agent-planned graphs or custom code, verified numeric tools and retained result/failure records.
svg.text: Generalized design for one vibration calculation
People set the target and criteria
Structure, electronic state, model, step, tolerance
Assess errors in the requested observable
Retain results and failures for reuse
Model, units, inputs, code and validation
Failure: stage, input and retry condition
Feed into new reference data and procedure changes
Reuse checked tools, versions and results
Conceptual design · planning and numerical execution are distinct.
